name: Fairfold
subtitle: A paper fairground, ride by ride
description: Fairfold is a book of flat-packed fairground rides. Open a page, find the order the hinges allow, and the carousel stands up off the paper. The first chapter is twelve hand-made rides, each teaching one idea; later chapters fill the fairground, and the children you built them for come to ride. No lives, no timers. One purchase removes ads; a hint is there when you want one.
